title: PGC: Peak-Guided Calibration for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection

local_evidence_refs.finding: CommGen15 is introduced as a challenging benchmark from 15 commercial generators. Original open proposal only; not an accepted scientific disposition.
Original bounded review question and preserved evidence requirements.
Current tasks=detection; research_types=method; retained evidence tier/source remains traceable.

Assign dataset only when construction, release, curation, or systematic provision of a reusable dataset/data resource is itself a substantive paper contribution. Data generated or collected solely to run the paper's experiments is insufficient.

Assign benchmark only when the paper contributes a reusable evaluation benchmark, challenge, protocol, systematic comparative framework, or benchmark resource intended to evaluate methods. Large experimental tables or evaluation across many generators alone are insufficient.

rationale: CommGen15 is an explicit paper contribution with documented acquisition, source URLs, composition and standardized image/frame preprocessing (R1). Its balanced binary task, external-training generalization setting, fixed-threshold accuracy/AP and comparative evaluation form a reusable benchmark resource (R2); support does not rest on generator count or result-table size.

identity_verification.title_and_authors: PDF p1 and cached PMLR landing match canonical title and six-author sequence.
identity_verification.arxiv: 2605.21207 retained from canonical input; no arXiv version or equivalence check performed.
identity_verification.version: Official PMLR 306 ICML 2026 PDF, 21 pages including appendix; cached landing cites 164828–164848 and 2026-09-29. PDF metadata creation 2026-05-20 is not the publication date.
identity_verification.differences: No competing full-text version inspected; all scientific claims below are bounded to this cached PMLR PDF.

R1.reason: p2 contribution list; §3 p3 acquisition from official galleries/community repositories and COCO real controls; Appendix C pp13–16 composition/source/version detail; p9 research-only release statement.

R2.reason: Reusable balanced real/fake image-and-frame evaluation resource; §5.1 p5 training sets, baselines and AP/Acc with threshold 0.5; Tables3/12 pp6/17 specify SDv1.4 external training and per-platform testing. No within-CommGen15 train/validation split is established.

scientific_review.empirical_validity: Paper-reported results only; source/semantic confounds, dependence between frames and test-set selection were not independently audited.
scientific_review.causal_interpretation: CAM/SHAP and robustness observations do not independently establish the proposed foreground suppression mechanism; preprocessing claims about eliminating biases are author interpretations.
scientific_review.availability: p1 code URL and p9 research-only dataset release claim recorded; no code/data link, license text or live download verified during recovery.
scientific_review.reproducibility: Source URLs and transformations are documented; dynamic galleries, hidden platform processing and incomplete per-sample version provenance limit reconstruction from the manuscript alone.

evidence.locator: PDF p2 contribution bullet; §3 Data Collection/Data Processing p3; Appendix C Dataset Composition/Standardization Pipeline p13
evidence.claim: Resource construction is a named contribution, collecting platform outputs rather than local inference; COCO 2017 real images balance the binary task. Raw images and extracted frames are center-cropped to 320×320 and saved as PNG; Hunyuan sampled every 30 frames, other video sources every 60.

evidence.locator: Table 1 p3; Appendix C pp13–16, Figure7 p14 and Table 10 p15
evidence.claim: Nine static-image platform subsets and six video-derived frame subsets must remain distinct. Sora row contains 1,275 community-sourced static outputs despite Sora being primarily a video model. Table 10 provides platform/source URLs; manuscript versions include GPT-4o, FLUX.1/1.1 variants, Imagen4, multiple Ideogram variants, Aperture Max, Nano Banana family, Sora v1, SD1.5, Doubao-Seedance-1.0-pro, Kling1.6 and Veo2/3; not every platform has a uniquely pinned model version.

evidence.locator: §5.1 p5; Table3 p6; Appendix D.1/E.1 p16; Table 12 p17; Impact Statement p9
evidence.claim: The dataset is supplied for evaluation with specified external-training settings and Acc/AP metrics, alongside a research-only release claim. Detector implementation applies a further 224×224 center crop; do not confuse it with stored dataset crop size.

quantitative_evidence.locator: Table 1 p3; Appendix C p13; Table 10 p15
quantitative_evidence.caveat: Generated-sample total combines static images with correlated frame derivatives, not 33,394 independent still-image generations. Video count 5,130 is arithmetic sum of Table 1 parentheses, not a separately reported total.
Preserve Frames (Videos) units; source-video counts cannot be used as frame counts.

quantitative_evidence.locator: §5.2 p6; Appendix E.1 p16 / Table 12 p17
quantitative_evidence.reported: PGC 97.9% mean Acc and 99.0% mean AP; DDA 85.6% mean Acc and 97.0% mean AP.
quantitative_evidence.caveat: 12.3 percentage-point Acc difference and 2.0-point AP difference, not a 12.3% relative improvement; tabulated cross-platform means are not independently verified pooled accuracy.

limitations: Dataset includes video-derived frames and some platforms with editing/identity-centric functionality; this review adds no video, attribution or face-manipulation task/scope label.

Gallery acquisition and platform descriptions do not verify every output provenance or exact model revision; Table 10 URLs are manuscript-reported as of May 16, 2026, with a Sora-service discontinuation caveat.
No independent download/availability, licensing audit, duplicate/near-duplicate audit, frame-level independence check or performance reproduction.
External-training evaluation is explicit; no unsupported claim of a dedicated CommGen15 train/validation/test split.
confidence: High for bounded R1/R2 contribution support; moderate for practical reproducibility.
